grounding.states: Tom Brady is the NFL GOAT pick
grounding.from: Tom Brady is still widely treated as the NFL GOAT.
He has 7 Super Bowl wins (7-3 all-time)

value.answer: Depends which football you mean. For soccer I'd go Messi. Most recent coverage is leaning his way, and he has 8 Ballon d'Ors to Ronaldo's 5. If you mean American football, I'd go Tom Brady, 7 Super Bowl wins is hard to argue with, though Mahomes is the one closing in.
